subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets operator gates ignore lower-severity findings?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and default-compatible, but deciding whether secrets-audit findings may be non-blocking under an operator-selected threshold is security/product policy, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR now and invite a secops/CLI owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the new public CLI contract as an opt-in gate because the default remains `info` and the PR already includes docs, tests, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller owner-approved gate, such as limiting threshold behavior to specific finding classes or folding it into a broader audit/doctor policy design.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR now and invite a secops/CLI owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has the strongest feature-history connection to the secrets audit flow and CLI/docs contract affected by this decision.
